events.head: Scan for unreferenced guide images and find running local servers
events.input: $ n=0; for f in $(find app/public/guides -name '*.webp' | sort); do rel=${f#app/public/}; if ! grep -rqF "$rel" app/src/content app/src/generated app/public/playbook-parts app/public/materials workshop-plan/playbook.html app/src/lib/shot-text.json 2>/dev/null; then b=$(basename $rel .webp); d=$(basename $(dirname $rel)); echo "UNREF? $rel"; n=$((n+1)); fi; done; echo "candidates: $n"; find app/public/guides -name '*.webp' | wc -l; lsof -iTCP -sTCP:LISTEN -P 2>/dev/null | grep -E "node|next" | awk '{print $1,$2,$9}'; cat .claude/launch.json | head -40; git diff --stat -- app/src/generated app/p
